title: Protocol Warden suite: multiplexed tool-call regression and golden-seed conformance
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Build a repeatable, CI-driven test harness (Protocol Warden) that validates end-to-end compatibility for multiplexed streaming + function/tool calling across runtime shims and model variants. The suite will use curated golden prompts, injected partial-response/noise scenarios, and lightweight tool stubs to assert JSON/ndjson framing, interleaving correctness, toolcall idempotency, and graceful fallback behavior. This ticket covers harness implementation, a seed corpus of golden prompts, CI integration, and initial runbook for triage.
acceptance_criteria: Protocol Warden harness can run in CI and exit non-zero on contract violations
Golden prompt corpus (>= 120 seeds) includes edgecases: truncated JSON, interleaved toolcall fragments, concurrent streams, and partial KV cache priming scenarios
Tool stubs used by tests support deterministic responses and failure injection (timeouts, 500s, malformed payloads)
Cross-variant checks: tests run against hosted shim, dedicated shim, and model-quantized variant; results recorded to a dashboard
Failure classification produced (schema drift, interleaving, non-deterministic ordering) with links to repro seeds and suggested mitigations
Baseline CI gate: a lightweight smoke run executes on pull requests, and nightly full-suite runs produce regression alerts
test_plan: 1) Implement harness runner that spins up an ephemeral tool-proxy and runtime shim harness. 2) Convert golden seeds to ndjson and parameterize seeds for model/seq-length/stream-chunking. 3) Add mutation layer: drop-chunks, reorder fragments, inject extra separators, simulate partial KV cache. 4) Add assertions: stream framing integrity, toolcall idempotency, JSON roundtrip, fallback route validation. 5) Wire results to metrics dashboard and CI alerting (Slack + email).
implementation_notes: Use existing stream proto fuzzer from ENG-19914 for mutation primitives. Reuse tool stub infra from ENG-62309 but add deterministic mode for golden-seed reproducibility. Persist run artifacts (raw traces, reconstructed messages, assertion diffs) to S3 and link to dashboard. Aim for <8m smoke-run time on CI; full run can be queued on nightly runners with parallel shards.
risks_blockers: Ephemeral tool stub flakiness in CI (mitigation: deterministic mode + pinned container images)
Large golden corpus increases nightly runtime (mitigation: sharding and sampling strategies)
Inconsistent model shims across environments may produce false positives (mitigation: preflight shim compatibility checks)
Access to dedicated environments for nightly runs requires infra quota approvals
